text:
maya: Quick partner sync — want to align on the content funnel for the CloudAtlas marketplace listing. Two big assets: a lightweight benchmark story + a joint webinar. Need owners, UTMs, and lead routing.

omar: Love that. Benchmark should focus on real dev workloads not synthetic. My proposal: 3 verticals (chat assist, doc summarization, semantic search embeddings) with cost/latency comparison hosted vs dedicated. Short narrative + downloadable CSV.

lee: For the narrative: keep it <600 words with 3 callouts: avg latency, cost per 100k tokens, and reliability (p99). Also add a short methodology blurb so buyers trust the numbers.

sam: I can run the webinar ops. Recommended format: 20m demo (Redwood+integration), 15m customer case, 10m live Q. Prefer Wed/Thu late AM PT. Who are speakers?

maya: Speakers: Lee (product demo), CloudAtlas PM (integration overview), and Jenna from AcmeCorp for the case study. Sam — can you lock Jenna? Also ask CS for a short 2-slide success metric.

omar: I'll own benchmark data & the CSV export. ETA: first draft Monday EOD. Will include a short appendix of infra config (model, batch size, quantization).

maya: Great. UTMs we should standardize so partner leads map cleanly. Suggest: 
```
utm_source=cloudatlas&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=amplify-q2&utm_content={asset}
```
where {asset}=benchmark|webinar|blog. Anyone object?

lee: That works. For landing page tracking we also need a hidden form field: partner_listing=cloudatlas and pass through utm_campaign.\n
sam: On routing: recommend this rule -> if lead.source contains "cloudatlas" then route to SFDC queue "Partners - Marketplace"; if predicted ARR > 50k then add tag "High ARR" and assign to AE; else route to SDR queue. I'll draft the flow and share.

maya: Copy. Also we need messaging iterations — two headlines to test on listing + webinar promo. My drafts: 
1) "Ship LLM features that scale — predictable latency, lower token costs"
2) "From prototype to production: inference that keeps bills low and SLAs high"
Which reads better for partners?

lee: I prefer #2 for marketplace listing (more enterprise-y). #1 for webinar promos. We'll A/B across channels.

omar: small ask — include a one‑paragraph FAQ in the benchmark asset addressing "When to pick Dedicated vs Hosted" with a simple decision table. I'll write it.

sam: Timelines: webinar live week of Apr 10, dry run Apr 7. Can we get benchmark draft Mon, landing page copy Wed, final assets Thu?

maya: Sounds good. Assignments recap: Omar = benchmark/data; Lee = landing copy + demo; Sam = webinar ops + routing doc; Maya = publish coordination + partner comms.

calendar-bot: Created event "CloudAtlas co-marketing dry run" Apr 7 10:00-11:00 PT — https://calendar.company/events/abcd1234 :calendar:

maya: small marketing ops note — please add the following tag to all assets: "partner:cloudatlas" so we can filter performance in GA and the content board.

sam: On it. I'll also add the Slack thread for live ops on day-of.

lee: +1. Anything else?

maya: Not yet. I'll post the asset deadlines in the partner drive and link them here when ready. :thumbsup:
